name: Bomdila
description: Headquarters of West Kameng district, a scenic hill station at over 2500 m elevation known for apple orchards, monasteries, and panoramic Himalayan views on the route to Tawang.
facts: District headquarters of West Kameng at approximately 2415-2507 m elevation
Known for Bomdila Monastery (GRL) and surrounding apple orchards
Important stopover on the Tezpur-Tawang highway with tourist lodges and craft centers

name: Bomdila Monastery (GRL / Upper Gompa)
description: Prominent Tibetan Buddhist monastery (Gontse Gaden Rabgyel Ling) perched on a hill overlooking Bomdila, with upper and lower sections, prayer halls, and panoramic valley views.
facts: Also known as Gontse Gaden Rabgyel Lling or GRL Monastery, built in 1965
Features upper gompa on hilltop with school and lower sections
Offers sweeping views of Bomdila valley and surrounding Himalayan ranges

name: Dirang
description: Picturesque valley town in West Kameng famous for hot springs, Dirang Dzong, kiwi and apple orchards, and as a gateway toward Sela Pass and Tawang.
facts: Located at about 1620 m elevation in a wide river valley
Home to Dirang Dzong (historic fort) and natural hot water springs with mineral properties
Hosts National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS)

name: Dirang Dzong
description: Ancient fortified settlement and historic dzong (fort) near Dirang town, reflecting traditional Monpa architecture and strategic past.
facts: Historic fort and old settlement associated with Dirang valley
Traditional stone and wood architecture typical of the region
Important cultural landmark on the route through West Kameng

name: Dirang Hot Springs
description: Natural geothermal hot springs near Dirang known for mineral-rich waters believed to have therapeutic properties.
facts: Natural hot water springs near Dirang town
Popular stop for travelers seeking relaxation in the valley
Part of the geothermal potential of the region

name: Sangti Valley
description: Serene hidden valley about 14 km from Dirang, featuring green meadows, terraced fields, Sangti River, fruit orchards, and winter visits by black-necked cranes.
facts: Located approximately 14 km from Dirang along the Sangti River
Known for scenic meadows, orchards, and migratory black-necked cranes in winter
Popular for picnics, walks, and offbeat nature experiences

name: Mandala Top
description: Scenic hilltop near Dirang featuring a circular arrangement of 108 Buddhist stupas (manes), offering panoramic views and a spiritual retreat atmosphere.
facts: Famous for 108 Buddhist stupas arranged in a circular layout
Scenic drive from Dirang through valleys with Brokpa yak herders sometimes visible
Popular for sunrise/sunset views and quiet reflection

name: Thembang Heritage Village
description: Ancient fortified Monpa village and UNESCO tentative World Heritage site near Dirang/Bomdila, known for stone dzong walls, traditional architecture, and cultural heritage.
facts: UNESCO Tentative World Heritage Site (Thembang Fortified Village)
Ancient settlement with traditional stone fortification and dzong architecture
Located in Thembang circle, West Kameng, at high elevation with rich Monpa culture

name: Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Biodiversity hotspot in West Kameng spanning elevations from 500 to over 3200 m, famous for birdwatching with over 450 species including the rare Bugun Liocichla, red pandas, and diverse Himalayan habitats.
facts: Established 1989, area approximately 217-218 sq km
Home to over 450 bird species including critically endangered Bugun Liocichla
Conjoins Sessa Orchid Sanctuary; part of Kameng Elephant Reserve

name: Sessa Orchid Sanctuary
description: Protected area dedicated to orchid conservation in West Kameng, spanning varied elevations with over 200 orchid species, adjoining Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary.
facts: Established 1989, covering about 100 sq km
First protected area specifically for orchids in India with rare Himalayan species
Located along Bhalukpong-Bomdila highway, adjoining Eaglenest

name: Tippi Orchid Research Centre
description: Orchid research centre and glasshouse at Tippi near Bhalukpong, housing thousands of orchid varieties on the banks of the Kameng River.
facts: Located at Tippi, about 65 km from Tezpur and near Bhalukpong
Features orchid glasshouse, tissue culture lab, herbarium, and museum
Showcases over 7,500 orchids representing Arunachal’s floral diversity

name: Bhalukpong
description: Entry-point town on the Assam-Arunachal border along the Kameng River, gateway for permits, rafting, angling, and access to Tippi and higher West Kameng destinations.
facts: Southern entry point to Arunachal Pradesh from Assam at about 213 m elevation
Inner line check post location; activities include river rafting and fishing
Close to Tippi Orchid Centre and ruins of historic interest

name: Lhagyala Gompa
description: Historic monastery overlooking Morshing valley, about 80 km from Bomdila, known for traditional Tibetan architecture and recent adventure activities like paragliding nearby.
facts: Situated on mountainside overlooking Morshing valley
Approximately 80 km from Bomdila
Seven-century-old monastery in the region with cultural significance

name: Chillipam Monastery
description: Hilltop monastery near Rupa offering spectacular 270-degree views of surrounding valleys, known for traditional architecture and serene setting.
facts: Located about 15 km from Rupa village
Built on a promontory with panoramic 270-degree valley views
Also known as Sangngag Choekhor Dargyeling or Zangdokpalri Monastery

name: Nyukmadong War Memorial
description: War memorial commemorating the 1962 Battle of Nyukmadung, located on a 1.5-acre site overlooking the historic battlefield between Dirang and Sela Pass.
facts: Commemorates the Battle of Nyukmadung on 18 November 1962
Located approximately 21 km north of Dirang on NH-13
Overlooks the battlefield site with space for reflection

name: Shergaon
description: Quaint village area in West Kameng known for horticulture farms, Choskorong Waterfall hike, and offbeat nature experiences away from main tourist routes.
facts: Features State Horticulture Farm and scenic pine landscapes
Access to Choskorong Forest and Waterfall via short hike
Less crowded alternative for experiencing local Monpa/Sherdukpen life
